review_scope: Admission to the independent 190-step B pilot only. Not a factual-correctness certificate, human review, or approval for the 1.6B main stage.
review_method: Read short head/middle/tail excerpts from 40 hash-priority candidate books, 20 new math documents, and 20 new DCLM documents; expanded to 3 replacement books and all 24 remaining DCLM sample documents after exclusions. Reused the hash-bound earlier A review for common source pools.
parent_initialization: Original own 20B native checkpoint with original Adam state; never pilot A or pretrained TinyLlama weights.
recipe: 30% original replay, 35% fresh DCLM, 20% fresh web, 5% narrative, 5% math, 5% code.

observations.narrative: Coherent fiction, memoirs, translated stories and some literary criticism. Excluded one book declaring missing text and one with repeated C1 encoding errors; the partially packed final book was excluded. Publisher credits, front matter, archaic language, historical prejudices, verse quotations and image captions remain. Not all-fiction or a modern-values/factual reference corpus.
observations.dclm: Inspected all 44 new document samples; final refill has 38 intact documents after five observed exclusions and one packing-tail exclusion. Removed a meme/social UI page, an inaccurate historical summary, local provider promotion, threat copypasta and a context-free event fragment. Broad news/opinions, interviews, gameplay reviews, educational prose and discussions remain, including contentious comments and boilerplate; factual correctness of all claims is not certified.
observations.math: Same source/artifact gate as A, with a new cached-source refill. Excerpts include derivations, question/answer discussions and corrections. Unresolved attempts, absent-figure references and some duplicated HTML/math rendering remain.
observations.shared_sources: Original A web/math/code/DCLM pools and their review are preserved and hash verified. New B refinements apply only to the tiny refill and narrative source, not retroactive editing of A or the original replay.

input_audit_boundary: Initial math/DCLM refills received post-build verification of actual frozen indices and old document DB; narrative build and review curation passed pre/post checks. The separate verifier preserves original builder hashes.
limitations: Assistant excerpt review, not independent human review or a calibrated whole-corpus semantic error estimate.
Source/title heuristics introduce topic and historical-period bias; metadata license labels are not independent legal certification.
Exact and sampled-span decontamination are not exhaustive paraphrase detection; old BoolQ contamination limitations remain.
Public benchmarks have been inspected; future scores are not an untouched hidden test.
No claim of surpassing TinyLlama or preserving every downstream ability before B evaluation.
All pilots, failures and recomputation share the same 2B training-token cap; original model remains available.
